RESERVA = {"sala": "Atlas", "inicio": "2026-10-05T10:00", "duracion_min": 60}


def test_crear_y_listar(client, auth):
    r = client.post("/reservas", json=RESERVA, headers=auth)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    creada = r.json()
    assert creada["usuario"] == "alice" and creada["sala"] == "Atlas"
    assert client.get("/reservas").json() == [creada]


def test_listado_ordenado_por_inicio(client, auth):
    client.post("/reservas", json={**RESERVA, "inicio": "2026-10-07T10:00"}, headers=auth)
    client.post("/reservas", json=RESERVA, headers=auth)
    inicios = [r["inicio"] for r in client.get("/reservas").json()]
    assert inicios == sorted(inicios)


def test_crear_sin_sesion(client):
    assert client.post("/reservas", json=RESERVA).status_code == 401
    assert client.post("/reservas", json=RESERVA, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer x"}).status_code == 401


def test_error_de_validacion_devuelve_422(client, auth):
    r = client.post("/reservas", json={**RESERVA, "sala": "Delta"}, headers=auth)
    assert r.status_code == 422
    assert r.json()["detail"]


def test_crear_con_fecha_en_vez_de_inicio_devuelve_422(client, auth):
    payload = {"sala": "Atlas", "fecha": "2026-10-05T10:00", "duracion_min": 60}
    r = client.post("/reservas", json=payload, headers=auth)
    assert r.status_code == 422


def test_filtrar_por_desde(client, auth):
    client.post("/reservas", json={**RESERVA, "inicio": "2026-10-05T10:00"}, headers=auth)
    client.post("/reservas", json={**RESERVA, "inicio": "2026-10-06T08:00"}, headers=auth)
    client.post("/reservas", json={**RESERVA, "inicio": "2026-10-08T10:00"}, headers=auth)

    r = client.get("/reservas", params={"desde": "2026-10-06"})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    inicios = [res["inicio"] for res in r.json()]
    assert inicios == ["2026-10-06T08:00:00", "2026-10-08T10:00:00"]


def test_filtrar_por_desde_formato_invalido_devuelve_422(client, auth):
    assert client.get("/reservas", params={"desde": "06-10-2026"}).status_code == 422


def test_sin_desde_devuelve_todas(client, auth):
    client.post("/reservas", json={**RESERVA, "inicio": "2026-10-05T10:00"}, headers=auth)
    client.post("/reservas", json={**RESERVA, "inicio": "2026-10-08T10:00"}, headers=auth)
    assert len(client.get("/reservas").json()) == 2
